I like, I want in Thai: 29 words with audio

This lesson teaches 29 Thai words for i like, i want in the Beginner part of the course, starting with ฉัน (I), คุณ (you), ชอบ (to like), กิน (eat). Each word is shown in Thai script with tone colours, romanization and its English meaning, and you can hear it spoken at normal and slow speed.

Go through the cards at your own pace, then take the quiz to check what stuck. When you are ready, practise the same words in 149 example sentences.
